name: Active Deliveries
query:
SELECT
    name,
    customer_name,
    delivery_zone,
    status,
    assigned_rider,
    delivery_attempts_count,
    creation
FROM `tabDelivery Order`
WHERE status NOT IN ("Delivered", "Cancelled")
  AND (
        %(delivery_zone)s IS NULL
        OR %(delivery_zone)s = ""
        OR %(delivery_zone)s = "All Zones"
        OR delivery_zone = %(delivery_zone)s
      )
ORDER BY creation ASC
